## Task

Describe the small change requested.

## Why this is a good first issue

- It is well-scoped (one file, one change).
- It does not require deep knowledge of the codebase.
- It is verifiable by running `npm test`.

## Steps

1. Fork the repository.
2. Make the change.
3. Run `npm test` to confirm nothing broke.
4. Open a PR referencing this issue.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The change is made.
- [ ] `npm test` passes.
- [ ] The PR title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/).
